title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-16
lineage: Cassette (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a legendary euphoria‑filled show highlighted by Janis Joplin’s guest spot on Lovelight and a soaring Candyman.
ai_review.review: The Miller transfer delivers an exceptionally clean soundboard recording that lets you hear every nuance, from Jerry’s spontaneous "Aw Fuck!" banter to the crowd‑level ambience. Musically the night is unforgettable – Janis Joplin joins for a fiery Lovelight and a sweetly sustained Candyman, making it one of the most celebrated performances in Dead lore.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews overwhelmingly praise both the performance (guest Janis, standout Lovelight and Candyman) and the crisp soundboard transfer; limited technical detail keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Transfer described as crisp and clean; stage banter and ambience captured without noted drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A euphoric, jam‑heavy set highlighted by Janis Joplin’s surprise appearance; the energy builds from the opening banter through a fiery Lovelight into an emotionally charged Candyman.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Stage banter captured (“Aw Fuck!”) and his interaction with Janis adds spontaneity.
